设 $F(x,y,z)=x-y-z,\quad G(x,y,z)=x^2-y^2-z^2$，则在点 $(1,1,0)$ 处有：
$$
F_x=1,\quad F_y=-1,\quad F_z=-1
$$
$$
G_x=2x=2,\quad G_y=-2y=-2,\quad G_z=-2z=0,
$$
$$
\frac{\partial(F,G)}{\partial(y,z)}=-2,\quad
\frac{\partial(F,G)}{\partial(z,x)}=-2,\quad
\frac{\partial(F,G)}{\partial(x,y)}=0,
$$
法平面为：$-2(x-1)-2(y-1)=0$，即 $x+y=2$，
$$
d=\frac{|-2-2|}{\sqrt{2}}=2\sqrt{2}.
$$
